focus.zh: 台灣半導體設備營收、伺服器液冷與東南亞機房供水
focus.en: Taiwanese semiconductor equipment earnings, server liquid cooling and Southeast Asian data-center water

throughline.zh: 奇鋐、均華、均豪與志聖公布 10 月營收，印尼巴淡島則由新採訪揭露機房周邊供水問題，台積電另回應記憶體製造傳聞。
throughline.en: AVC, Gallant, Gallant Micro and C Sun disclosed October sales as new reporting documented water-supply issues near Batam data centers and TSMC responded to a memory-fabrication report.

text.zh: 奇鋐 10 月合併營收 221.03 億元、年增 34.35%，未公布液冷產品獨立出貨量。
text.en: AVC reported NT$22.103B October revenue, up 34.35% YoY, without separate liquid-cooling shipment data.

text.en: Gallant reported NT$571M October revenue, up 280.14% YoY, and management cited packaging order visibility into 2027.

text.zh: 法新社報導印尼巴淡島居民供水中斷，供水單位指出乾旱與電力故障，機房取水因果待查。
text.en: AFP reported Batam household water outages; the utility cited drought and a power fault, with data-center causation unproven.

text.zh: 均豪 10 月營收 7.16 億元、年增 126.02%，涉及檢測量測及研磨拋光設備。

text.zh: 台積電發言人回應 3D DRAM 傳聞，重申公司將專注邏輯晶片專業代工。
text.en: TSMC's spokesperson reaffirmed its logic-foundry focus in response to the 3D DRAM report.

title.zh: 奇鋐 10 月營收 221.03 億元、年增 34.35%，公司公告因客戶需求增加
title.en: AVC posts NT$22.103B October revenue, up 34.35% YoY, citing stronger customer demand

summary.zh: 奇鋐 11 月 8 日公告 2026 年 10 月合併營收約 221.03 億元，年增 34.35%；今年前 10 個月合計約 1,793.51 億元，年增 65.58%。公告將營收成長歸因於客戶需求增加，但未公布液冷、傳統散熱或特定伺服器平台各自的月度出貨量。
summary.en: AVC disclosed October consolidated revenue of NT$22.103 billion on November 8, up 34.35% year on year, while January–October revenue reached NT$179.351 billion, up 65.58%. The company attributed growth to customer demand without providing product-specific monthly shipments for liquid cooling, air cooling or server platforms.

text.zh: 奇鋐供應伺服器與運算設備的散熱零組件及液冷系統，涉及冷板、熱交換和機櫃散熱。公司先前法說會對新品量產進度的預期應與本次已實現的 10 月合併營收分開閱讀。
text.en: AVC supplies thermal components and liquid-cooling systems used in servers and compute equipment, including cold plates and heat management. Earlier guidance about new products reaching volume production is distinct from October's reported consolidated sales.

text.zh: 10 月營收為 22,102,758 千元，去年同月 16,451,489 千元；前 10 個月累計 179,351,016 千元，去年同期 108,315,849 千元。中央社稱月增約 5.2%，連續第 3 個月創單月新高；合併營收包含所有業務。
text.en: The reported monthly figures were NT$22,102,758 thousand versus NT$16,451,489 thousand a year earlier; ten-month figures were NT$179,351,016 thousand and NT$108,315,849 thousand. CNA reported roughly 5.2% monthly growth and a third consecutive monthly record, across all businesses.

text.zh: 液冷占比、單套冷卻系統售價、各機櫃電力密度與客戶驗收件數未公布。
text.en: The liquid-cooling revenue share, per-system pricing, rack power density and customer acceptance volumes were not reported.

title.zh: 均華 10 月營收 5.71 億元、年增 280.14%，表示先進封裝設備訂單能見度至明年
title.en: Gallant reports NT$571M October sales, up 280.14% YoY, and cites packaging-equipment order visibility

summary.zh: 均華 11 月 8 日公告 10 月合併營收 5.71 億元，年增 280.14%；今年前 10 個月營收約 38.78 億元，年增 79.01%。總經理表示晶圓廠與封測廠增加先進封裝投資，訂單能見度延伸至 2027 年；這是公司對訂單的說明，未列出已驗收機台數。
summary.en: Gallant reported October revenue of NT$570.935 million on November 8, up 280.14% YoY, and January–October sales of NT$3.878 billion, up 79.01%. Management cited advanced-packaging investment at fabs and OSATs, with order visibility into 2027, but did not disclose accepted machine units.

text.zh: 均華主要供應半導體製造及封測相關自動化設備，營收隨設備交貨與驗收時間變動。總經理談到配合客戶需求準備赴美設立子公司，但尚未公布設立日期、投入金額或營運場址。
text.en: Gallant supplies semiconductor and packaging automation equipment, with revenue affected by equipment deliveries and acceptance timing. Management mentioned preparations for a US subsidiary but gave no incorporation date, investment value or operating site.

text.zh: 10 月營收 570,935 千元，去年同期 150,192 千元；前 10 個月合計 3,878,110 千元，去年同期 2,166,364 千元。10 月月增 14.5% 為媒體報導的變動率。與去年同期的比較基期使用公告原始數字。
text.en: October sales were NT$570,935 thousand versus NT$150,192 thousand in October 2025; ten-month sales were NT$3,878,110 thousand versus NT$2,166,364 thousand. Economic Daily News reported 14.5% sequential growth; the YoY bases are explicitly stated in the reproduced filing.

text.en: Equipment models, advanced-packaging share, customer acceptance windows, US incorporation and capex have not been disclosed.

title.zh: 法新社採訪巴淡島供水中斷與資料中心爭議，當地供水單位指出乾旱及電力故障
title.en: AFP reports Batam water outages and data-center protests; utility cites drought and power disruption

summary.zh: 法新社 11 月 8 日公布印尼巴淡島農沙地區居民與供水單位訪談，居民指稱資料中心擴建可能加劇供水緊張，當地供水商 Air Batam Hilir 則指出乾旱造成水庫水位下降，電力故障亦影響供水。巴淡島政府先前於 11 月 5 日宣布 Kabil 海水淡化廠動工，一期規劃每秒 300 公升，無證據證明資料中心已直接造成全部停水事件。
summary.en: AFP published new interviews on November 8 with residents and a water utility in Batam's Nongsa district. Residents questioned data-center water demands, while Air Batam Hilir cited drought, low reservoir levels and a power fault behind interruptions. A separate seawater desalination project broke ground in Kabil on November 5, with planned first-phase output of 300 liters per second; causation between specific data centers and outages has not been established.

text.zh: 巴淡島與新加坡以海底電纜相連，農沙數位園區聚集資料中心及數位服務設施。供水來源、機房冷卻水需求和居民供水網的實際連結必須依業者資料確認；此次報導未提供單一園區的實測用水量。
text.en: Batam is linked to Singapore through undersea cables and Nongsa Digital Park hosts data-center and digital infrastructure. Water sources and site cooling demand need facility-level records; the new report does not quantify measured water usage by any one operator.

text.zh: 中央社引述法新社 11 月 8 日採訪指出居民因供水中斷赴 Nongsa Digital Park 外抗議；Air Batam Hilir 說明乾旱令 Nongsa 水庫水位下降，供電故障進一步影響供水。BP Batam 11 月 5 日公告，Citramas Group 在 Kabil 興建海水逆滲透廠，一期 300 公升／秒、第二期規劃 400 公升／秒，整體約 700 公升／秒，一期目標 2027 年 11 月啟用；該工程已在本月 5 日動工，不能列為 8 日新開工。
text.en: AFP's November 8 reporting documented resident protests near Nongsa Digital Park and the utility's explanation of drought and electrical disruptions. BP Batam separately announced on November 5 that Citramas Group began a Kabil reverse-osmosis project with a 300-liter-per-second first phase and planned 400-liter-per-second second phase, totaling 700 liters per second; first-phase operation is targeted for November 2027. The November 5 groundbreaking is dated background rather than a new November 8 opening.

text.zh: 居民停水事件與個別資料中心取水的因果關係、園區實際用水量、各水庫即時監測及海水淡化廠交付驗收仍待公布。
text.en: The relationship between household outages and specific data-center withdrawals, site-level water consumption, current reservoir measurements and desalination acceptance remain unverified.

title.zh: 均豪 10 月營收 7.16 億元、年增 126.02%，聚焦檢量與磨拋設備
title.en: Gallant Micro reports NT$716M October sales, up 126.02% YoY, in metrology and polishing equipment

summary.zh: 均豪 11 月 8 日公布 10 月營收 7.16 億元，年增 126.02%；前 10 個月累計 50.08 億元，年增 33.72%。公司業務涵蓋半導體檢測量測及研磨拋光設備，但公告未拆分各製程或封裝客戶營收。
summary.en: Gallant Micro reported October revenue of NT$716.168 million on November 8, up 126.02% YoY, and ten-month revenue of NT$5.008 billion, up 33.72%. It supplies semiconductor metrology, grinding and polishing systems but did not break out revenue by process or packaging customer.

text.zh: 均豪的設備應用涵蓋檢測量測、研磨拋光、先進封裝與特殊載板，與晶圓再生及封測製程相連。公司對產業需求的敘述未附個別設備台數或稼動率。
text.en: Gallant Micro supplies inspection, metrology, grinding and polishing equipment for advanced packaging, wafer reclamation and specialized substrates. Commentary on market demand is not accompanied by machine-level deliveries or utilization.

text.zh: 10 月營收 716,168 千元，去年同月 316,866 千元；前 10 個月合計 5,007,838 千元，去年同期 3,744,917 千元。媒體報導單月月增 8.1%，公司備註營收變化是配合客戶出貨。
text.en: October revenue was NT$716,168 thousand versus NT$316,866 thousand a year earlier; ten-month revenue was NT$5,007,838 thousand versus NT$3,744,917 thousand. Media reported 8.1% sequential growth, and the filing noted shipments made to customer schedules.

text.zh: 檢測量測與磨拋設備各自金額、驗收件數及新產品資格認證尚未披露。
text.en: Revenue by metrology versus polishing, accepted machines and product qualification details were not reported.

title.zh: 志聖 10 月營收 10.13 億元、年增 80.68%，公司說明來自客戶需求提升
title.en: C Sun posts NT$1.013B October revenue, up 80.68% YoY, attributing growth to customer demand

summary.zh: 志聖 11 月 8 日公告 10 月合併營收 10.13 億元，年增 80.68%；今年 1 至 10 月累計 90.36 億元，年增 83.80%。公司表示成長與客戶需求提升有關，未公布先進封裝設備的獨立營收或訂單驗收台數。
summary.en: C Sun disclosed October consolidated revenue of NT$1.013 billion on November 8, up 80.68% YoY, with January–October sales of NT$9.036 billion, up 83.80%. The company cited higher customer demand but did not disclose distinct advanced-packaging revenue or acceptance volumes.

text.zh: 志聖供應電子與半導體製造設備，包含先進封裝及工廠製程相關應用。之前公布的自動化軟體業務股權安排與本次 10 月營收屬不同事件。
text.en: C Sun supplies electronics and semiconductor manufacturing equipment, including advanced-packaging and factory-process applications. An earlier equity arrangement in automation software is a separate development from October sales.

text.zh: 公司揭露 10 月營收 1,013,344 千元、去年同月 560,854 千元，前 10 個月 9,035,864 千元、去年同期 4,916,114 千元。公司於備註明列需求提升是營收同比增長的原因，但未提供不同設備線的比較基期。
text.en: The published figures were NT$1,013,344 thousand versus NT$560,854 thousand for October and NT$9,035,864 thousand versus NT$4,916,114 thousand for the ten-month periods. The company attributed the increase to customer demand without process-specific base figures.

text.zh: 各製程設備營收比例、先進封裝新機驗收、訂單能見度的確切契約基礎未披露。
text.en: Revenue by equipment type, new advanced-packaging machine acceptance and contractual order visibility were not disclosed.

title.zh: 追蹤：台積電回應 3D DRAM 傳聞，重申專注邏輯晶片晶圓代工
title.en: Follow-up: TSMC reaffirms logic foundry focus in response to 3D DRAM report

summary.zh: 台積電發言人於 11 月 7 日回應 Tom's Hardware 對 3D DRAM 製造傳聞的查詢，重申公司核心業務為專業晶圓代工，將持續服務全球邏輯晶片產業。回應沒有公布任何 DRAM 製造投資、產線或量產日期，也未逐一評論匿名報導中的技術合作細節。
summary.en: A TSMC spokesperson told Tom's Hardware on November 7 that the company remains dedicated to its pure-play IC foundry business and supplying logic-semiconductor technology and capacity. The statement did not announce DRAM investment, a new fab or a production timetable, nor did it address every alleged collaboration detail.

text.zh: 11 月 6 日 The Information 引述匿名人士稱台積電評估 3D DRAM，11 月 8 日預編版曾記載缺乏公司確認。這次的新事實是公司透過媒體正式重申邏輯晶片代工定位。3D DRAM 記憶體單元垂直堆疊與現行 HBM 多晶片封裝不是相同製程。
text.en: An anonymous-source story on November 6 suggested TSMC may evaluate 3D DRAM; the previous edition noted the absence of company confirmation. The new fact is the spokesperson's direct response. Vertically stacked 3D DRAM cells differ from packaging multiple DRAM dies for HBM.

text.zh: Tom's Hardware 11 月 7 日直接引述台積電發言人的電子郵件回覆，強調公司持續投入專業邏輯晶片代工。自由財經於 11 月 8 日報導該回覆；目前沒有董事會核准、正式設備合約或記憶體晶圓廠投產公告。
text.en: Tom's Hardware quoted TSMC's direct response on November 7, reiterating its logic-foundry role; Liberty Times covered that response on November 8. There is no board-approved DRAM program, tool contract or memory-fab commissioning disclosure.

text.zh: 匿名報導所述要求是否曾正式提出、台積電與客戶的研發合作內容，以及未來是否有單獨的記憶體製程開發案仍未確認。
text.en: Whether the alleged customer request was formal, its research scope and any separate future memory-process program remain unverified.

title.zh: 東捷 10 月營收 1.85 億元、年減 36.37%，前 10 個月營收年減 11.06%
title.en: Contrel October sales fall 36.37% YoY to NT$185M; ten-month sales down 11.06%

summary.zh: 東捷 11 月 8 日公布 10 月合併營收約 1.85 億元，年減 36.37%，今年前 10 個月合計約 18.51 億元、年減 11.06%。媒體報導 10 月營收月增 24.1%，但公司未提供出貨延後、產品組合或設備驗收造成同比下滑的具體說明。
summary.en: Contrel reported October revenue of NT$184.949 million on November 8, down 36.37% YoY, and ten-month sales of NT$1.851 billion, down 11.06%. A separate report cited a 24.1% monthly increase, but no disclosed product-mix or equipment-acceptance breakdown explains the annual decline.

text.zh: 東捷經營電子設備與自動化相關業務，其財報合併不同設備應用。單月收入可受出貨及驗收時程影響，但公司這次未揭露可驗證的單一原因。
text.en: Contrel operates in electronic equipment and factory automation. Revenue includes multiple product applications and may vary with delivery and acceptance timing, but the company disclosed no verified explanation for this period's YoY change.

text.zh: 公司公布 10 月營收 184,949 千元，去年同期 290,651 千元；前 10 個月營收 1,850,983 千元，去年同期 2,081,242 千元。前 10 個月合計年減 11.06%，與單月年減 36.37% 應分開比較。
text.en: The filing shows October sales of NT$184,949 thousand versus NT$290,651 thousand a year earlier, and ten-month revenue of NT$1,850,983 thousand versus NT$2,081,242 thousand. The ten-month decline of 11.06% differs from October's 36.37% YoY decline.

text.zh: 減少的營收所屬產品、個別客戶、出貨或驗收時間變動未揭露。
text.en: The affected product lines, customers and delivery or acceptance timing were not specified.

ceoView.zh: 對工業設備電源及自動化量測供應商而言，東捷的月營收與累計營收呈現不同幅度的同比變動。需要再確認產品線出貨及設備驗收資料，無法直接認定客戶需求或市占率發生結構性改變。
ceoView.en: For industrial power and automation metrology vendors, Contrel's monthly and ten-month figures show different declines. Product shipments and acceptance data are needed before assigning a cause.

question.zh: 奇鋐營收成長是否代表液冷產品出貨同比增幅？
question.en: Does AVC's sales growth quantify liquid-cooling unit shipments?

text.zh: 10 月公告屬所有產品合併營收，未分列液冷營收與件數；去年同期金額及成長率可以直接核對。
text.en: October figures are consolidated across products and lack liquid-cooling revenue or unit breakdown, while year-earlier revenue and reported growth are explicitly provided.

question.zh: 巴淡島供水中斷是資料中心造成的嗎？
question.en: Did data centers cause Batam's water outages?

text.zh: 居民提出疑慮，Air Batam Hilir 提到乾旱、水庫水位下降及電力故障。尚無可核對的個別資料中心取水量或水網因果證據。
text.en: Residents raised concerns, while the utility cited drought, reservoir depletion and an electrical fault. Facility-level withdrawals and causal evidence are missing.

question.zh: 台積電是否已確認投入 3D DRAM 量產？
question.en: Has TSMC confirmed 3D DRAM mass production?

text.zh: 發言人僅重申現有專業晶圓代工定位，沒有投資核准、製程規格或量產時程。
text.en: The spokesperson reaffirmed TSMC's foundry mandate without approved investment, process specifications or a production timeline.

title.zh: 巴淡島海水淡化工程的原始公告日期
title.en: Original date of Batam desalination groundbreaking

text.zh: 印尼 BP Batam 在 11 月 5 日已宣布 Kabil SWRO 海水淡化廠動工，一期規劃每秒 300 公升，2027 年 11 月為預計營運時點。本次新增的是 11 月 8 日法新社採訪與供水單位說明，不將舊工程重新列為新開工。
text.en: Indonesia's BP Batam had already announced the Kabil SWRO groundbreaking on November 5, with 300 liters per second planned in phase one and November 2027 as the targeted operating date. The new development is AFP's November 8 reporting and utility interviews, not a second construction start.

text.zh: 11 月 8 日有媒體提及低碳電力直供與轉供修法，但未找到足以核對草案條文與程序狀態的正式公告，暫不列為生效政策新聞。
text.en: Reports on November 8 described a proposal for direct supply and wheeling of CCS-backed power, but an authoritative legislative text and status were not established. It is not treated as an enacted policy.

text.zh: 單純股票行情、分析師推估設備訂單與重複舊有建廠消息未收錄。
text.en: Share-price reactions, speculative equipment orders and repeated older construction announcements were excluded.

verificationNote.zh: 五家上市櫃公司 10 月營收以媒體轉載的公司月報數字及經濟日報、中央社交叉核對，未逐一取得公開資訊觀測站原始電子申報。均華所述 2027 年訂單能見度是管理階層說法，並非驗收機台數。巴淡島居民停水與資料中心取水的因果關係未經證實；Kabil 海水淡化工程於 11 月 5 日動工，產能仍屬規劃。台積電僅公開重申專業晶圓代工定位，匿名 3D DRAM 報導的所有細節未逐一確認。
verificationNote.en: The five companies' October figures were checked against reproduced company revenue disclosures and established reporting, not original exchange submissions for each issuer. Gallant's 2027 order visibility is a management statement, not accepted equipment volume. Batam outages have not been causally attributed to data centers; the Kabil desalination project broke ground November 5 and its capacity is planned. TSMC reaffirmed its foundry role without resolving every claim in the anonymous 3D DRAM report.
